bio.zh:
你好，我是孙嘉渝，浙江大学 2027 年秋季入学的准博士生（incoming PhD），主要从事具身智能领域的研究。目前，我就读于电子科技大学信息与软件工程学院，也是穆尧老师指导下的访问学生。

我仍在寻找自己的科研主线与志同道合的朋友，也在不断学习具身智能各个方向的基础知识。

科研之外，我仍在努力减肥。我喜欢学习不同领域的知识，最近在学习博弈论与经济学；跨领域的学习总能让我从新的角度认识世界。我也喜欢阅读人物传记，例如《乔布斯传》和《人类群星闪耀时》。我热爱篮球、羽毛球和健身，欢迎找我打球、约练。或许未来某一天，我也会尝试绘画、音乐等艺术领域。

我将在这个网站记录科研与学习中的思考和感悟，逐步打造自己的个人信息管理中心。
bio.en:
Hi, I'm Jiayu Sun, an incoming PhD student at Zhejiang University starting in Fall 2027. My research focuses on embodied AI. I am currently a student at the School of Information and Software Engineering, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC), and a visiting student under the supervision of Prof. Yao Mu.

I'm still finding my research direction and looking for like-minded friends, while continuing to learn the foundations of different areas of embodied AI.

Outside research, I'm still working on losing weight. I enjoy learning across disciplines, and lately I've been studying game theory and economics. Exploring different fields always gives me new ways to see the world. I also enjoy biographies, such as Steve Jobs and Decisive Moments in History. I love basketball, badminton, and working out—feel free to join me for a game or a workout. Someday, I may also try drawing, music, and other forms of art.

On this website, I'll share reflections from my research and learning, gradually building a personal hub for organizing knowledge and information.
